page.title: 7. Version Closure
page.description: Verify that planning and tasks are complete before sealing and publishing the production version.
page.selectProject: Select a project to audit its closure.

closed.title: Project Closed and Production Version Published
closed.description: This project was completed and sealed for production version v{{version}}. Further changes to scope, planning, and tasks are permanently blocked.
closed.history: Sealed History of Planning and Delivered Tasks ({{count}})

audit.title: Production Planning and Task Audit
audit.description: All tasks must be complete before project closure can be authorized.
audit.noPlanning: No planning items registered for this project.
audit.noTasks: No tasks linked to this planning item.

releaseNotes.title: Production Release Notes (Changelog)
releaseNotes.description: Describe the deliveries, fixes, and new features in this project.
releaseNotes.placeholder: E.g. Version 1.0.0 release with authentication, reports, and performance improvements...

seal.title: Production Seal and Closure
seal.requiresTask: The version must have at least one task before publication.
seal.pendingExplanation: There are {{count}} pending task(s) {{scope}}. Closure is authorized only when all tasks are complete.
seal.readyDescription: All tasks are complete. You can seal the project and publish the production version.
seal.warning: Warning: closure is permanent. Once closed, the project cannot be reopened or edited.

confirm.title: Confirm Project Closure and Publication
confirm.versionDescription: Publish production version "{{version}}"? This is permanent and will complete all {{count}} linked projects.
confirm.projectDescription: Close project "{{name}}"? This is permanent and will prevent future changes.
